verified: Live, Aug 2026, against a Veeva posting. No react root, no fiber keys - server-rendered.

match.notes: Board index jobs.lever.co/<org>, embeddable with ?embed=true. Public JSON of every posting uuid: api.lever.co/v0/postings/<org>?mode=json (no key). Source tracking via ?lever-source=<x>.

apply_url.note: The posting page is not the form; /apply is.

upload_first_why: CRITICAL RACE: Lever parses the resume SERVER-SIDE and asynchronously overwrites name/email/phone/org/urls a second or two after upload, clobbering anything already typed. Upload first, wait for the parse to land, THEN write your values over the top. Fill-then-upload silently loses data.

wait_parse.why: Poll until the server-side parse has written into input[name=name], then let it settle before overwriting.
wait_parse.on_timeout: continue - the parse is a convenience, not a requirement; the fields step overwrites everything that matters anyway

fields.note: input#resume-upload-input[data-qa=input-resume].application-file-input.invisible-resume-upload. Real input behind the styled control.
Lever wants ONE full-name field, not first/last.

Autocomplete that writes a JSON blob into hidden input[name=selectedLocation]. Typing the city and leaving selectedLocation empty is normally accepted. If the form rejects it, redo this field with method autocomplete_pick.

question_map.how: Every custom question is cards[<card-uuid>][field<N>] with a sibling hidden cards[<card-uuid>][baseTemplate]. Radios and checkboxes share the name. Discover, then map each label through answer_rules.
question_map.discover_js: (async()=>{const out=[];const seen=new Set();document.querySelectorAll('[name^=cards]').forEach(e=>{const n=e.name;if(/\[baseTemplate\]$/.test(n))return;const t=(e.type||'').toLowerCase();const key=t==='radio'||t==='checkbox'?n:n+'#'+(e.id||'');if(seen.has(key))return;seen.add(key);const tag=e.tagName.toLowerCase();let type='text',sel=tag+'[name='+CSS.escape(n)+']',opts=null;if(t==='file')type='file';else if(tag==='textarea')type='textarea';else if(tag==='select'){type=/select2/.test(e.className||'')?'select2':'select';opts=[...e.options].map(o=>o.text)}else if(t==='radio'){type='radio_group';sel='input[name='+CSS.escape(n)+']';opts=[...document.querySelectorAll(sel)].map(r=>({value:r.value,label:__lbl(r).slice(0,80)}))}else if(t==='checkbox'){type='checkbox';sel='input[name='+CSS.escape(n)+'][value='+CSS.escape(e.value||'on')+']'}const card=e.closest('.application-question,li,.card');out.push({name:n,label:(card?__txt(card.querySelector('.text,.application-label,label,legend')||card):__lbl(e)).replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,300),type:type,selector:sel,options:opts,required:/required/i.test((card&&card.className)||'')||e.required===true})});return out})()
question_map.select2_note: class select2-hidden-accessible. jQuery is on the page, so select_by_text routes through $(el).val(v).trigger('change'). A bare value set leaves the visible select2 label stale.
typical: Are you currently located in / willing to relocate to <city>?
How did you hear about us? (select2)
Degree, school, graduation year (three linked selects on new-grad reqs)
Consent to AI-assisted screening (required checkbox, newer)
EEO/demographic block as its own card

verify.how: plan() builds a single JS readback over every field it filled and compares against step.expect.
verify.fail_closed: Any MISSING, empty required field, or NO_OPTION -> human_queue.
verify.why_it_matters_here: This is the platform where a mis-sequenced upload silently reverts your values, so the readback is the only proof the parse did not clobber you.

submit.gate: db.claim(uid) must return before this click - it re-checks the tier-1 gate, auto_submit and the per-company caps. Irreversible.
submit.note: Click the VISIBLE submit button only. hCaptcha resolves a token and then triggers the hidden button#hcaptchaSubmitBtn itself.
submit.confirm: URL becomes .../apply/thanks or get_page_text contains the thank-you copy

captcha.where: div#h-captcha.h-captcha[data-sitekey=...] with newassets.hcaptcha.com frames; usually passive/invisible
captcha.risk: Renders a real challenge on suspicious IPs.

do_not_touch.why: Captcha token fields. Writing to one is a bypass attempt - out of scope, permanently. Detection only; a visible challenge is human_queue.
The hidden real submit that hCaptcha triggers once its token resolves. Clicking it directly is a captcha bypass - forbidden. Click the visible submit button and let hCaptcha do its thing.
Hidden JSON blob owned by the location autocomplete. Hand-writing it desyncs the widget; leaving it empty is normally accepted.
Hidden card metadata Lever uses to reassemble the answer. Never write to it.
